thread:
Sophia: quick ask — product wants a short scorecard + recommendation for onboarding 'Aurora-11B' into the GTN pilot. Can ML run a tiny quant sweep (fp16, static-int8, dynamic-int6) on the 3 eval suites (conversational, summarization, search-relevance) and return: unit cost per 1M tokens, delta vs fp16 for Rouge/accuracy/emd, latency P50/P99, and a routing suggestion? Need digestable guidance for Henry by EOD Wed.

Maya: ack. We'll run the sweep but want to confirm constraints: target P99 <= 800ms for chat path? and product cost goal?

Henry: target P99 700ms ideally but can accept 900ms if cost improvement > 2.5x. Goal: move hosted token cost down while keeping user-facing quality drop <= 2% absolute on key metrics (convo intent + summary ROUGE-L).

Alex: infra can spin a 4xA10 pool for the sweep. Estimate ~6 GPU-hours per config for representative traffic sample (short/med/long tokens). I can queue it tonight.

Maya: plan — small A/B style experiment:
1) run fp16 baseline on 5k queries from each eval set (measure quality + latency)
2) run static-int8 and dynamic-int6 quant on same inputs, measure token/sec and metric deltas
3) compute unit econ using a simple formula and estimate hosted per-token cost if using Dedicated pricing baseline

Maya: snippet for unit cost calc we'll commit to reproducible numbers:
```
# simplified unit cost per 1M tokens
gpu_hour_usd = 2.2  # example A10 reserved cost/hr
hours = gpu_seconds / 3600.0
tokens = total_generated_tokens
unit_cost_per_1M = (gpu_hour_usd * hours) / (tokens / 1e6)
```
I'll attach actual measured tokens/sec after runs.

Maya: quick back-of-envelope from prior runs (for reference only):
- fp16: 20k tokens/sec, p99 chat ~420ms, quality = baseline
- dyn-int6: 32k tokens/sec, p99 chat ~380ms, quality delta convo ~-1.6% absolute on intent acc, summary ROUGE-L -1.8
- static-int8: 28k tokens/sec, p99 chat ~400ms, quality delta convo ~-0.9%, ROUGE-L -1.1
Using those numbers and gpu_hour_usd=2.2, unit_cost_per_1M (approx):
- fp16 ~0.39 USD
- dyn-int6 ~0.24 USD
- static-int8 ~0.28 USD
(again, very rough until we run the sweep)

Henry: these are the right knobs. For GTN pilot, product preference: prioritize cost but preserve conversational quality. If dynamic-int6 gives ~1.5x-1.8x cost reduction with <=2% quality drop, we can route there for short interactive queries.

Maya: recommendation draft (subject to sweep):
- Default route: dynamic-int6 for queries <= 160 tokens and where model-confidence >= 0.85 (see scoring below)
- Fallback: fp16 for long queries (> 160 tokens) or when confidence < 0.85 or low-shot prompt patterns
- Graceful degrade: if dyn-int6 p99 spikes >900ms, fallback to static-int8 or fp16 depending on current cost budget

Maya: confidence scoring (quick heuristic to compute at runtime):
```
# heuristic confidence
conf = softmax_peak(logits) * (1 - entropy_norm)
if conf < 0.85: route to fp16
else: route to dyn-int6
```
This is intentionally simple for the pilot.

Sophia: for the scorecard please include: metric, fp16 baseline, delta-int6, delta-int8, token/sec, cost/1M, recommended traffic % for pilot, operational flags (cache, prefix reuse). Suggest columns: eval_set, fp16_metric, int6_metric, int8_metric, int6_delta, int8_delta, p50/p99, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1M, recommendation.

Alex: I'll push infra job and deploy-bot will post run artifacts to /anvil/results/aurora-173950. Maya, please confirm exact eval sets/ids and I'll start.

Maya: eval sets = conv_v2_5k, summarization_prism_5k, search_recall_5k. Start queue now.

deploy-bot: job queued: aurora-173950-sweep | configs: fp16, static-int8, dynamic-int6 | pool: 4xA10 | est run time 18h | artifact prefix /anvil/results/aurora-173950

Henry: thanks team. After the sweep can you also give a one-paragraph blurb I can paste in GTN PR explaining the tradeoffs and recommended default? Keep it business-friendly (cost uplift %, expected user impact).

Maya: will do. Assigning owners: Maya -> run/summarize sweep, Sophia -> write scorecard template + draft blurb, Alex -> infra + artifacts. Will post interim numbers in this thread.

Sophia: appreciate it. If anything looks off with int6 quality we can try a hybrid: int6 for LM layers except the final 2 layers kept fp16 (cheap to test) — that sometimes recovers ~0.4-0.8% quality.

Maya: noted. I'll add a hybrid config if int6 deltas are borderline.

Alex: starting jobs now. ETA artifacts tomorrow morning.

Maya: thanks — will aim to have a condensed scorecard + recommendation ready by EOD Wed.

Henry: perfect. :tada:
